The '''Dairka system''' was located in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] model known as the [[Dairkan Starliner]].<ref name="Wedge">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dairka [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-15.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
